title: WebChannelEvent
description:
The tagged, strongly typed web event contract.

Optional fields are omitted to preserve the deployed struct's wire shape.
The `chat_error` variant intentionally remains able to represent the legacy
`error_type: "cancelled"` payload during the compatibility window.

A normalized provider event projected to the web client. The nested
payload remains the canonical TinyChannels event contract, including
its version, channel/conversation identity, and typed event kind.

openhuman_message_id.description:
OpenHuman's persisted row ID for the canonical event's target, when
the host has an exact durable provider-receipt binding.

Tenant/profile stamps belong to the host and must never cross the wire.

ButtonAction.description: One provider-neutral action button in an ordered content row.

ButtonStyle.description: Visual button emphasis; it does not change action authority.

ChannelEvent.description: One normalized event emitted by a channel provider.

conversation.description: Full conversation address. Presence events may omit it.

eventId.description: Stable adapter event ID, suitable for host-side deduplication.

sourceEventId.description: Provider event ID, retained verbatim when supplied.

sourceTimestamp.description: Provider timestamp in Unix milliseconds, when supplied.

version.description: Event vocabulary version. This DTO currently represents contract v2.

oneOf.description: A provider reports a user's typing state.
A provider confirms that a message was delivered or read.
A provider confirms delivery of a message.
A user added a reaction.
A user removed a reaction.
A sent reaction's provider result.
A provider edited an existing message.
A provider deleted an existing message.

A user activated an opaque provider button. The host applies any
approval or business policy after validating this actor and scope.
Account or user presence changed.
Provider connection/lifecycle status changed.

ChannelReaction.description: Provider reaction identity, including optional custom emoji identity.

value.description: Displayable reaction text, such as an emoji.

ContactMethod.description: One typed phone number or email address on a contact card.

markdownDialect.description: Formatting dialect; formatting remains text, never HTML authority.

ConversationRef.description: Reference to an inbound or outbound conversation.

MediaReference.description: One inbound media reference, preserving provider attachment order.

opaqueId.description:
Host-owned identifier for media stored outside the provider. It is
opaque and only meaningful with the full channel, conversation, and
turn scope used to store it.

OutboundContentPart.description: Typed outbound parts accepted by migrated provider adapters.

OutboundVoice.description: Explicit outbound voice operation. Synthesis is opt-in and keeps its text.

VoiceNote.description: Audio message metadata and optional transcript enrichment.

VoiceTranscript.description: Transcript enrichment attached to a voice note without replacing its audio.

VoiceTranscriptState.description: Whether a voice transcript is still being produced or is final.

WebCostSource.description: Cost provenance copied as a wire enum to avoid depending on the harness.
